✓ Shares all the time — in the background and after restarts
To share all the time, finish the steps below

Sharing is on. To keep it on in the background and after the phone restarts, Android needs location access \"Allow all the time\".\n\nTap Open settings, then Permissions → Location → Allow all the time.
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. Let GeoTracker run without battery restrictions so sharing isn\'t interrupted.

Once you turn sharing on, the owner of this tracker will see in real time, all the time:

• your location, accuracy, speed and heading
• your battery level and charging state
• this phone's model, Android version and IP address

Sharing stays on in the background and after the phone restarts, until you pause or stop it here. A notification is always shown while it's on.
Location permission is needed to share your location.
Hold for 2 seconds to alert the tracker owner. This does NOT contact emergency services — in an emergency, call your local emergency number.
